subject: fix(optimizer)!: Handle pseudocolumns differently than columns (#6273)

+def _qualify_columns(
+    scope: Scope,
+    resolver: Resolver,
+    allow_partial_qualification: bool,

     """Disambiguate columns, ensuring each column specifies a source"""
